title: Replace CDN links with GitHub Pages and modernize dictionary theme
description:
## Summary

The legacy `rsacdn.link` CDN is being retired. This repo now publishes via **GitHub Pages** (enabled on `main`, root). This PR repoints the data dictionary references to Pages URLs and removes the CDN-hosted styling from the dictionary sources.

## Changes

- **Repoint data dictionary links (milestone files):** the `indexes` dictionary now links to `https://rstudio.github.io/academy-python-stock-portfolios/assets/indexes_dictionary.html` instead of `rsacdn.link`.
- **Modernize the dictionary sources:** all three `assets/*_dictionary.qmd` files (indexes, sectors, sp500) were R Markdown (`output: html_document` + `cerulean` theme + a `teachthis` CDN stylesheet). They now use native Quarto `format: html` with the default **cosmo** theme and `embed-resources: true` (self-contained single files, no external CDN assets).
- **Re-rendered** all three dictionary HTML files.

## Verification

- `grep` confirms **no** `rsacdn`, `cerulean`, or `teachthis` references remain in any `.qmd` or `.html`.
- Dictionaries re-rendered self-contained (no `_files/` sidecar).
- GitHub Pages enabled and building; live dictionary URL returns HTTP 200.
